purpose: Sanitized extract of saved experiment reports for the portfolio. The underlying private archive is not included.
audit_method: Read-only inspection of saved reports, recorded images and local provenance notices. No new training, live capture, serial output or application changes were performed for this extract.

qualification.recorded_installation_status: Installed as an incremental user-authorized trial
qualification.note: Passing software regressions and incremental update checks does not establish full model accuracy or end-to-end live latency.

software_regressions.scope: Saved unittest result for the recovery candidate; not rerun during this evidence audit.

identity_lock.scope: Selection and identity association only. Synthetic sequences reproduce the alternating-target bug; tracker timing excludes screen capture, inference, verification and USB.

reacquisition.sequence_type: Synthetic 50 FPS dropout and pan sequence
reacquisition.scope: Unnecessary selector wait after a fresh single-enemy observation. These numbers are not total input latency or model inference latency.

body_processing.scope: Processing of saved scenes on the local GPU while the existing app and game ran. Excludes capture-to-USB and physical movement latency.

body_recovery_regressions.scope: Reused development and regression images, correlated crops, multiple scales and settings. Check counts are not counts of independent people or encounters. Accepted selections do not necessarily imply correct anatomical placement.

distant_bot_recovery.scope: Accepted body points on 18 correlated range-bot frames. The recording label describes the test; this is not independent broad real-agent accuracy. Chest and stomach recovery remains weak.

fresh_recorded_replay.scope: Offline comparison on a fresh captured sequence, with no Arduino output. No extra acquisition benefit was observed in this sequence.

head_recall_audit.scope: Reused labelled static scenes, not independent live accuracy. CPU FP16 replay disabled the static second-pass time budget. Raw proposals already apply confidence and coarse teammate rules.

body_model_release_gates.scope: Original pose-model release metadata. Later incremental processing and regression checks do not satisfy all original model qualification requirements.

limitations: The full anatomical model remains unqualified under its original release gates.
Fourteen inherited hidden-region selections and six inherited background-crop selections remain in reused regression sets.
Three additional accepted landmarks were outside tiny labelled regions by approximately 0.10, 0.60 and 1.00 pixels and remained counted as failures.
Distance detail recovery covers only the central 192 native pixels. The head-only branch and model weights were unchanged by that recovery update.
Most missed heads in the static recall audit had no eligible raw proposal; the reacquisition repair does not improve the model's raw detections.
Screen geometry cannot guarantee identity through complete overlap or arbitrary occlusion. A model box merging two people requires a detection fix beyond target locking.
These regression images and correlated crops were reused during development. Results must not be described as independent game-wide accuracy or guaranteed zero false positives.
Recorded-frame replay demonstrates selected coordinates, not proof of in-game hits or physical output response.

provenance_records.scope: Reported by local source manifests and retained notices, not a comprehensive redistribution-rights determination for datasets, game artwork or pretrained weights.

mixed_dataset.split_note: Recording groups inferred from filename suffixes; public labels may be imperfect; not every playable agent is covered.
